verdicts.reason: A has no collisions, but its hierarchy is broken. The body copy is set almost as large as the headline and dominates the lower left, while the CTA button, 'Ships late June' and the legal text shrink to an illegible cluster on the right. The 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow is gone, and the logo is tiny. B is unusable: the last headline lines run into the body copy, the orange divider strikes through 'Smoked Rosemary', and the logo crowds the header band. These collisions outweigh its otherwise reasonable CTA prominence.
